sections.title: Company Overview
sections.text:
JOHNSON ARABIA is a Mobile Crane and Aerial Work Platforms (AWP) hire company based in United Arab Emirates which offers cost-efficient and versatile lift engineering solutions to the petrochemical, civil engineering, construction, industrial, utilities, aviation, marine and other industries and clients.
JOHNSON ARABIA was established in 1999 and is the most valuable market leader that sets trends and records around the region with dedicated and professional staff committed to excellence in Safety, Maintenance, Availability, Reliability and Total cost effectiveness.
From its initial location in Dubai, JOHNSON ARABIA has expanded its operations in Abu Dhabi, Oman and Saudi Arabia. JOHNSON ARABIA currently operates its own fleet of approximately 250 Mobile Cranes and 900 Aerial Work Platforms.

sections.title: Managing Director's Message
sections.text:
Johnson Arabia has built a strong reputation for providing reliable and cost effective but above all safe crane & access solutions for twenty five years.
The company is dedicated to the welfare of its employees and committed to provide the very best services to its customers and partners. When you choose Johnson you become a part of our culture and philosophy to never accept anything other than the best quality products, providing the highest level of support and to never stop improving through training and sharing knowledge.
Johnson Arabia will be enhancing its products and services in the coming months and years and will be expanding into many different regions. Thank you for your trust in our business, we look forward to sharing our philosophy with you and meeting new customers, partners and friends.

sections.title: Health, Safety & Environment Policy
sections.text:
Johnson Arabia LLC believes that the Health, Safety and Environment along with the welfare of its employees and others affected by its operations should have equal importance to quality, cost, production and morale. Our mission is to provide professional crane and work platform services to our clients while encouraging our team to work effectively in accordance our Health and Safety Management System.
This policy can only be successful with the active co-operation of all management, employees, contractors and visitors, who have a duty to offer all necessary assistance to ensure the Health and Safety of them and others.

sections.title: Lift Planning & Engineering Services
sections.text: Johnson Arabia provides lift planning, method statements, site surveys, ground condition assessments, and slab loading calculations. No obligation — our engineers are available for consultation on any lifting project.

sections.title: IPAF Training Center
sections.text:
Johnson Arabia lays a high emphasis on safety, be it their own people or their clients or suppliers. After building a strong foundation in the AWP industry since 2004, Johnson Arabia decided to become an internationally approved Training Center in 2015 through which they can help educate AWP users in the market on the safe, competent, productive and effective use of AWPs. This is in line with Johnson Arabia's plans to contribute to the growth of the markets they operate in. Since 2015, Johnson Arabia is an accredited member of the International Powered Access Federation (IPAF) providing training in various categories around the UAE.
IPAF promotes the safe and effective use of Aerial Work Platforms worldwide in the widest sense - through providing technical advice and information; through influencing and interpreting legislation and standards; and through safety initiatives and training programmes. IPAF is a not-for-profit organisation owned by its members, which include manufacturers, rental companies, distributors, contractors and users. IPAF members operate a majority of the MEWP rental fleet worldwide and manufacture about 85% of platforms on the market.

sections.title: Crane Operator Training
sections.text: Johnson Arabia provides in-house crane operator training covering all crane types in their fleet. Specialist categories available for mobile cranes, crawler cranes, and tower cranes.
